title: Services: Java
description: post-command-service and social-service (Spring Boot, Micrometer over OTLP). Pick the service at the top.

panels.title: Instances reporting
panels.description: Instances that sent metrics in the last 2.5 minutes. 0 means the service is down or cannot reach the collector.

targets.expr: count((process_uptime_milliseconds{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(process_uptime_milliseconds{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: HTTP requests per second, health probes excluded.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests that failed on the server side (HTTP 5xx, or the gRPC server error codes).

targets.expr: (sum (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Latency p99
panels.description: 99% of the requests were faster than this.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: CPU used by the JVM, as a share of the CPUs it can use.

panels.title: Heap used
panels.description: Heap in use over the maximum heap. It rises and falls with GC; a floor that keeps rising is a leak.

targets.expr: sum((jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="heap"} unless time() - timestamp(jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="heap"}) > 150)) / sum((jvm_memory_max_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="heap"} unless time() - timestamp(jvm_memory_max_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="heap"}) > 150) > 0)

panels.title: DB pool in use
panels.description: Connections in use over the pool maximum. At 100% new operations wait for a connection.

targets.expr: sum((hikaricp_connections_active{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(hikaricp_connections_active{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150)) / sum((hikaricp_connections_max{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(hikaricp_connections_max{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150))

panels.title: Error logs (5 m)
panels.description: Log lines at error level or above in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Starts in range
panels.description: Times the service logged that it finished starting in the selected range. More than one per instance means it restarted.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restart count of the service's containers (Kubernetes). It grows on crashes, OOM kills and failed liveness probes.

panels.title: Containers ready
panels.description: Containers passing their readiness probe (Kubernetes).

panels.title: Time to ready
panels.description: How long the last start took until the service could take traffic.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the JVM started (the youngest instance).

panels.title: Starts over time
panels.description: Each point is a completed start: find when the service restarted, then read the startup log next to it.

panels.title: Startup log
panels.description: The lines a start produces: configuration, connections, migrations, listeners, and the failure when it did not come up.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} |~ `Starting \w+Application|Started \w+Application|profile is active|profiles are active|HikariPool-\d+ - (Start|Shutdown)|Tomcat (initialized|started)|[Mm]igrat|APPLICATION FAILED TO START|Application run failed|Error starting|[Gg]raceful shutdown|Commencing graceful`

panels.title: Kubernetes events
panels.description: Events of the service's pods: scheduling, image pulls, failed probes, BackOff, OOMKilled. A crash before the service could send its logs only shows up here; read its output with kubectl logs --previous.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests that failed on the server side.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: By route
panels.description: Rate, error ratio and p99 of each route over the last minutes.

targets.expr: (sum by (uri) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (uri) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (uri) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: CPU and memory of the containers (Kubernetes)
CPU
panels.description: CPU cores each pod uses, with the container's request and limit. At the limit the container is throttled.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set of each pod: what the OOM killer compares with the limit.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Receive above zero, transmit below.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU of the JVM and of its whole container, as a share of the CPUs available.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) ((jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="heap"} unless time() - timestamp(jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="heap"}) > 150))

sum by (service_name) ((jvm_memory_committed_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="heap"} unless time() - timestamp(jvm_memory_committed_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="heap"}) > 150))

sum by (service_name) ((jvm_memory_max_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="heap"} unless time() - timestamp(jvm_memory_max_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="heap"}) > 150) > 0)

panels.title: Non-heap by pool
panels.description: Metaspace, code cache and class space.

targets.expr: sum by (id) ((jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="nonheap"} unless time() - timestamp(jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", area="nonheap"}) > 150))

panels.title: GC pauses
panels.description: Stop-the-world time of the garbage collections.

panels.title: GC overhead
panels.description: Share of CPU time spent in GC. Above 10% for long, the heap is too small.

panels.title: Threads by state
panels.description: Many blocked or waiting threads point to a lock or a slow dependency.

targets.expr: sum by (state) ((jvm_threads_states{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(jvm_threads_states{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150))

sum by (service_name) ((process_files_open{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(process_files_open{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150))

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: In use, idle and the pool maximum. Waiting operations mean the pool is exhausted.

panels.title: Pool in use
panels.description: At 100% every new operation waits for a connection.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum((hikaricp_connections_active{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(hikaricp_connections_active{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150)) / sum((hikaricp_connections_max{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(hikaricp_connections_max{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150)))

panels.title: Wait for a connection p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: How long an operation waited to get a connection. It should stay near zero.

panels.title: Connection timeouts
panels.description: Operations that gave up waiting for a connection.

panels.title: Time a connection is held p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: How long the code keeps a connection before returning it. Long holds exhaust the pool.

panels.title: Repository calls p99
panels.description: The slowest Spring Data repositories.

panels.title: Failures
panels.description: Rejected messages went to their DLQ. Failed or nacked publishes stay in the outbox and are retried.

panels.title: Failed messages by queue
panels.description: Messages whose handling failed after the retries: they went to the queue's DLQ.

panels.title: Processing time p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Time to handle a message, retries included.

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: Log volume by level. A jump in error or warn is usually the first sign of a problem.

panels.title: Loggers with most errors
panels.description: Which class or package logged the errors in the selected range.

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: Warn level and above. Open a line to see its trace id and jump to the trace in Tempo.

panels.title: All logs (filter with Log search at the top)
panels.description: Every log line of the service. Type in Log search to filter; the match is case-insensitive.
